benchmark_queries.prompt: How many total clients are onboarded in the database?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_clients FROM clients

benchmark_queries.prompt: Count the number of active demat account holders
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_demat_count FROM clients WHERE demat_active_flag = TRUE AND account_status = 'ACTIVE'

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show client distribution by wealth tier
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM clients GROUP BY tier ORDER BY client_count DESC

benchmark_queries.prompt: How many clients reside in Maharashtra?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS maharashtra_clients FROM clients WHERE state = 'Maharashtra'

benchmark_queries.prompt: List client counts across geographical zones
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT zone, COUNT(*) AS count FROM clients GROUP BY zone ORDER BY count DESC

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the total number of trade fills recorded in the book?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_trades FROM trades

benchmark_queries.prompt: How many orders have been placed in total?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

benchmark_queries.prompt: List all order counts by status
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY status

benchmark_queries.prompt: How many instruments are tradable on NSE?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nse_instruments FROM instruments WHERE exchange = 'NSE'

benchmark_queries.prompt: Count instruments by market segment
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS count FROM instruments GROUP BY segment

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the total gross turnover across all executed trades?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(turnover), 2) AS total_gross_turnover FROM trades

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the total brokerage revenue collected?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(brokerage_amount), 2) AS total_brokerage FROM trades

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the gross turnover and trade count by market segment?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT i.segment, COUNT(t.trade_id) AS trade_count, ROUND(SUM(t.turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id GROUP BY i.segment ORDER BY turnover DESC

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show turnover contribution broken down by client wealth tier
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT c.tier, COUNT(t.trade_id) AS trade_count, ROUND(SUM(t.turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades t JOIN clients c ON t.client_id = c.client_id GROUP BY c.tier ORDER BY turnover DESC

benchmark_queries.prompt: List total brokerage earned by client zone
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT c.zone, ROUND(SUM(t.brokerage_amount), 2) AS brokerage FROM trades t JOIN clients c ON t.client_id = c.client_id GROUP BY c.zone ORDER BY brokerage DESC

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the total turnover for HNI clients in FNO_OPTIONS?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.turnover), 2) AS hni_options_turnover FROM trades t JOIN clients c ON t.client_id = c.client_id JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE c.tier = 'HNI' AND i.segment = 'FNO_OPTIONS'

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show total order volume and rejection counts by client tier
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT c.tier, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) AS rejected_orders FROM orders o JOIN clients c ON o.client_id = c.client_id GROUP BY c.tier

benchmark_queries.prompt: List the top 5 trading instruments by total turnover
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT i.tradingsymbol, i.segment, ROUND(SUM(t.turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id GROUP BY i.tradingsymbol, i.segment ORDER BY turnover DESC LIMIT 5

benchmark_queries.prompt: Find top 10 retail clients with highest executed turnover
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.name, ROUND(SUM(t.turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades t JOIN clients c ON t.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.tier = 'RETAIL' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.name ORDER BY turnover DESC LIMIT 10

benchmark_queries.prompt: Calculate STT tax collected per market segment
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT i.segment, ROUND(SUM(t.stt_tax), 2) AS total_stt FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id GROUP BY i.segment ORDER BY total_stt DESC

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show completed orders vs rejected orders for BankNifty options
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders o JOIN instruments i ON o.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE i.tradingsymbol LIKE 'BANKNIFTY%' GROUP BY o.status

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the total exchange fee paid by Super HNI traders?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.exchange_turnover_fee), 2) AS exchange_fee FROM trades t JOIN clients c ON t.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.tier = 'SUPER_HNI'

benchmark_queries.prompt: List client counts and active trade counts for top 5 cities
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS clients, COUNT(t.trade_id) AS trades FROM clients c LEFT JOIN trades t ON c.client_id = t.client_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY trades DESC LIMIT 5

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show average trade execution size in lots across segments
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT i.segment, ROUND(AVG(t.traded_quantity / NULLIF(i.lot_size, 0)), 2) AS avg_lots FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id GROUP BY i.segment

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show monthly turnover trend across 2024
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', trade_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

benchmark_queries.prompt: Compare Thursday expiry turnover against other weekdays
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT CASE CAST(strftime('%w', t.trade_timestamp) AS INTEGER) WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, ROUND(SUM(t.turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE i.segment = 'FNO_OPTIONS' GROUP BY day_type

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show daily trade execution counts for August 2024
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT DATE(trade_timestamp) AS trade_date, COUNT(*) AS trade_count FROM trades WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', trade_timestamp) = '2024-08' GROUP BY trade_date ORDER BY trade_date

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the peak hourly trading volume between 9:15 AM and 3:30 PM?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%H', trade_timestamp) AS trade_hour, COUNT(*) AS fills, ROUND(SUM(turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades GROUP BY trade_hour ORDER BY turnover DESC

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show monthly brokerage revenue trend
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', trade_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(brokerage_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM trades GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

benchmark_queries.prompt: Track daily order rejection rate percentage during August
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT DATE(order_timestamp) AS o_date, ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS rejection_rate FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_timestamp) = '2024-08' GROUP BY o_date ORDER BY o_date

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show turnover split between July and August for Options
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', t.trade_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(t.turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE i.segment = 'FNO_OPTIONS' AND strftime('%Y-%m', t.trade_timestamp) IN ('2024-07', '2024-08') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

benchmark_queries.prompt: Compare weekly options turnover on Thursdays vs Fridays
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT CASE CAST(strftime('%w', trade_timestamp) AS INTEGER) WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' END AS day, ROUND(SUM(turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM trades WHERE CAST(strftime('%w', trade_timestamp) AS INTEGER) IN (4, 5) GROUP BY day

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show trade count trend by day of week
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%w', trade_timestamp) AS dow, COUNT(*) AS trade_count FROM trades GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow

benchmark_queries.prompt: How did active client transacting count trend month over month?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', trade_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS active_clients FROM trades GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

benchmark_queries.prompt: List daily orders placed between August 10 and August 18
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT DATE(order_timestamp) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE DATE(order_timestamp) BETWEEN '2024-08-10' AND '2024-08-18' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date

benchmark_queries.prompt: What was the total volume on Thursday expiry dates?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.turnover), 2) AS expiry_turnover FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE i.segment = 'FNO_OPTIONS' AND CAST(strftime('%w', t.trade_timestamp) AS INTEGER) = 4

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is our overall order fill rate by order type?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETE' THEN 1 END) AS filled_orders, ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETE' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS fill_rate_pct FROM orders GROUP BY order_type

benchmark_queries.prompt: Calculate average brokerage yield in basis points by market segment
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT i.segment, ROUND((SUM(t.brokerage_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(t.turnover), 0)) * 10000, 2) AS yield_bps FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id GROUP BY i.segment

benchmark_queries.prompt: Calculate RMS margin rejection rate percentage
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' AND rejection_reason = 'RMS_INSUFFICIENT_MARGIN' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS rms_rejection_rate FROM orders

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the total order rejection rate across all reasons?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS rejection_rate FROM orders

benchmark_queries.prompt: Calculate F&O turnover contribution share percentage
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN i.segment IN ('FNO_OPTIONS', 'FNO_FUTURES') THEN t.turnover ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(t.turnover), 0), 2) AS fno_share_pct FROM trades t JOIN instruments i ON t.instrument_id = i.instrument_id

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the count of active Demat clients transacting in July 2024?
benchmark_queries.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS active_demat_clients FROM trades WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', trade_timestamp) = '2024-07'

benchmark_queries.prompt: What is the net brokerage revenue collected in equity cash?

benchmark_queries.prompt: Show brokerage yield in bps broken down by client tier
